items.html: For behold, during the time of pregnancy, those Mochin were in the aspect of the Names of Aleph-Lamed-Mem of Elokim, as above, and they lacked the essence of the Mochin, which are the letters Yod-Hei, in order for them to be a complete Elokim. Therefore the infant was then mute (ilem), in the secret of 'Or who makes a man mute?' And behold, now the Mochin were filled with the letters Yod-Hei, and became a complete Elokim.
